overview_description.description: Lock&Stock is a mobile application that encourages people to improve their focus by reducing their screen time. Users collect rewards for the time they spend away from their phones and can use their rewards to sponsor education for underprivileged children. is a Dubai-based edtech and digital wellness company that develops mobile platforms designed to reduce screen addiction and improve student productivity through reward-based engagement systems. Founded in 2017 by Craig Fernandes, the company encourages students to stay off their phones during study hours and rewards them with scholarships, discounts, offers, and educational benefits for maintaining healthier digital habits.
